title: Noom reviews: ratings, research and FutureClinic compared - FutureClinic
summary: Noom reviews: Better Business Bureau ratings, what the published studies show, how plans renew and cancel, and how a FutureClinic doctor compares.
body_markdown:
## Noom and FutureClinic side by side


Feature Noom A FutureClinic doctor


What you get Lessons, logging, coaching; optional med plans One-to-one medical care by message


Who guides you Welli AI, Noom Coaches ("not licensed medical professions") State-licensed physician (MD, DO or MBBS)


Who prescribes "Licensed clinicians" (outside clinical partners) Your FutureClinic physician, with Human Signature


Subscription Upfront auto-renewing; cancel 11:59 p.m. ET day prior No subscription required; optional memberships


Pharmacy Compounded includes medicine; brand separate Sent to the pharmacy you choose


Access App lessons, AI and coach chat Same doctor by message, typically same day


Paid (November 2026) Noom Weight $70/month, $169/4 months, $209/year $40 best-fit, or chosen ($20 to $100)


Prices checked on November 8, 2026.


## Who should pick Noom


Noom suits people seeking a daily behavior-change program of 5 to 15 minute psychology lessons, color-coded food logging and coaching, which FutureClinic does not offer in that form. Noom's homepage offers "instant access to AI and human-led coaching via chat" for someone wanting answers in minutes. A FutureClinic doctor replies in hours, typically the same day. FutureClinic has no proprietary or compounded formulas and sends prescriptions only to the pharmacy you choose. Someone wanting compounded medicine bundled into a subscription can pick Noom's compounded plan.


## When a doctor of your own fits better than an app


Did you want Noom's app of lessons, food logging and coaching, or a doctor of your own evaluating your weight and health? If you want the app's program, Noom is a strong option. If you wanted an expert doctor, FutureClinic gives you that with nothing attached.


The[American Association of Clinical Endocrinology](https://www.aace.com/patient-journey/obesity/initial-assessment) notes a weight assessment can include blood pressure, eating disorder screening, and fasting blood sugar, cholesterol and liver labs. Across FutureClinic's over 300 doctors, generalists and specialists alike, every clinician is a physician (MD, DO or MBBS),[never a nurse practitioner or physician assistant](https://futureclinic.com/blog/nurse-practitioner-vs-doctor-who-treats-you-online) . AI works like a chief resident organizing your history without giving medical advice. A specific doctor reads your case and replies with a recorded video or voice note, the Human Signature. No form is approved in bulk. Care is by message, with no live video visits.


You message the same doctor in one thread to manage side effects, adjust doses, or compare labs over time. Your doctor earns nothing extra for any prescription or test. That doctor can help with other problems in their specialty, and FutureClinic spans more than 60 specialties, all working from your one medical record.


If your doctor decides it's right for you, they can prescribe[FDA-approved medicines](https://futureclinic.com/blog/weight-loss-medication-online-no-membership-fee) to the pharmacy you choose, mail-order included, where insurance may cover them (FutureClinic helps with prior authorizations) or a discount coupon lowers the cash price, including several months of a stable medicine when safe.[Wegovy](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/search.cfm?query=wegovy) (about 15% trial loss at 2.4 mg) and[Zepbound](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/search.cfm?query=zepbound) (15% to 21% vs 2% to 3% on placebo) are indicated with diet and activity for adult obesity (BMI 30+) or overweight (BMI 27+) with a weight-related condition; both warn of thyroid C-cell tumors and pancreatitis, and weight often returns after stopping ([NIDDK](https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/weight-management/prescription-medications-treat-overweight-obesity) ). Self-pay as of October 2026:[NovoCare](https://www.novocare.com/patient/medicines/wegovy.html) Wegovy tablets are $149 to $299/month and 2.4 mg pens $349/month ($199 first two months for new patients);[LillyDirect](https://www.lilly.com/lillydirect/zepbound) Zepbound is $299 to $449 per 28 days on time (up to $699 otherwise). FutureClinic doctors do not prescribe compounded GLP-1s or controlled medicines like phentermine.


## Talking with a FutureClinic physician about your weight


A FutureClinic visit is $40 for the best-fit doctor, or a chosen doctor's listed price, typically $20 to $100, with[no subscription required](https://futureclinic.com/blog/telehealth-subscriptions-vs-paying-a-doctor-per-visit-yearly-cost) . Most doctors offer an optional membership for unlimited care with that doctor, typically $25 to $100 a month, cancel any time. FutureClinic operates in 34 states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. If your state is not listed, try anyway, as FutureClinic may have opened there since.


Visit[futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) to start a conversation with a doctor right away, or connect from your AI app at[futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) or by sending:` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt` . Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want. FutureClinic is not for emergencies: call 911 in an emergency, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.
